pages.text: It was an ordinary Monday morning when <name> noticed something odd about his school bag. The zipper had little arrows carved into it — up, down, loop, and twist. “Hmm,” <name> murmured, tracing the pattern with his finger. The zipper suddenly sparked!

Ziiip! Before he could blink, <name> was no longer in his room. He stood on a bright silver sidewalk where children zoomed past on hover-skates and shiny robots waved, saying, “Good morning, students!”
“Whoa!” <name> gasped. “Did my bag just… time travel?” A robot teacher rolled up with a kind smile. “Welcome to Future School! Today’s lesson — cloud coding!”

<name> couldn’t believe it. The classrooms floated in the air, lunchboxes refilled themselves, and buses flew through rainbow-colored clouds. Everything was so cool — until his school bag’s little clock began blinking red!
“Oh no,” said <name>. “If it stops ticking, I might get stuck here!” The robot teacher beeped in concern. “We must stabilize its time circuits!”

<name> thought hard. He remembered his science lessons — electricity needs circuits to flow! He connected his pencil’s metal clip to the zipper, used a paperclip to bridge the battery pocket, and smiled. “Science mode: ON!”
Click! Whirrr! The clock blinked green again. “Good thinking, young inventor,” said the robot teacher. “Your curiosity saved the day!”

Before leaving, <name> waved at the future kids. “Thanks for the lesson!” Another Ziiip! — and he was back in his room, bag glowing softly. That morning, <name> packed his books with a big grin. He now knew — even ordinary things can hide extraordinary adventures, if you’re curious enough to look.
